name: One Voice in the Briars
tagline: Three battles for a valley that has never followed one keeper.
description: Ash-Muzzle means to unite the scattered woodland packs. A chief’s private revenge has brought human spears into their feeding woods. Win the packs, recover the groves, and break the occupation before the valley is cleared.
shortDescription: Lead woodland folk against a local chief’s revenge.

ending.text: The packs do not move into a palace, and Old Root does not bow to one. But when a runner brings word of spears on the trail, they gather at the same keep. Ash-Muzzle has the voice he fought for; now he has to answer it.
ending.speaker: Afterwards
